questions.question: Before the battle of Jericho, Joshua met a man holding a drawn sword. Who did the man say He was?
Israel marched around Jericho once a day for six days. What did they do on the seventh day?

answers.text: Camped and waited at the gates

questions.question: When Joshua's army captured Jericho, whose household was the only one allowed to live?

answers.text: Rahab and all those with her
Tamar and all those with her
Deborah and all those with her

questions.question: After Jericho fell, what did Joshua say would happen to any man who rebuilt the city?

answers.text: He is cursed before the LORD
He is blessed with a great name
He will rule over all the land
